title: Man. Post. Cap. VII: Quarto close — do not foster such thoughts of God
pass_a_gloss: So Placeus begs his dearest brother in Christ not to foster such thoughts of God—they strike him with horror. Fifth and last: the Apostle helps—Gal. 6:5 Each will bear his own burden; Rom. 14:12 Each of us will give account of himself to God.
pass_b_english: Do not, then, I beg you, dearest brother in Christ, foster such thoughts about God, which to me at least certainly strike horror. Fifth and finally, let the Apostle's words to Gal. 6:5 help us: Each will bear his own burden. And to Rom. 14:12: Each of us will give account of himself to God.
source_text: Noli igitur, quaeso, frater in Christo dilectissime, tales de Deo cogitationes fovere, quae mihi quidem certe horrorem incutiunt. Quinto denique, succurrant nobis Apostoli verba ad Gal. 6. 5. Unusquisque suum onus portabit. Et ad Rom. 14. 12. Unusquisque nostrum de seipso rationem reddet Deo.
